title: Measure greatness by what the heart clings to
summary: True greatness is loving attachment to the Lord, not to Maya's scale. Receive the gift without claiming the outcome.
takeaway: Receive the gift without claiming the outcome.
lifeApplication: Before grasping harder, pause with one hand open and let refuge matter more than possession.

source.shortMeaning: True greatness is loving attachment to the Lord, not to Maya's scale.
source.lifeApplication: When status enters the room, ask what your heart is serving before comparison hardens.
